author: neatcleaver
body:
The preferred weapon bonus is 5% so the bow is basically the same as the sword 

697 + 5% would be 731 total rounded down or 732 if it's rounded up, not sure what Orna does for that

So I'd go with the Deathbringer for the orn + exp bonuses

author: Cptnwhizbang
body: I would use the deathbringer for most content. Rough math makes the others look similar but you get bonus Orns and XP (from some sources not all).

author: Eden1506
body:
From tier 7 to tier 9 going summoner is the laziest and most comfortable way to level as they don't need good gear for most content within those tiers and you can focus on items giving you the most bonus orn/exp/gold etc instead.

If you want to stay melee I would try to upgrade that deathbringer for even greater boni and keep using it.

As levelling gets slower you want to maximise the rewards you get out of each fight especially as tier 9 gets closer.

author: Angel-of-Barriers
body:
As many say, The Deathbringer is the way to go for melee.

GL on your Venin/Questing Bow Search in T9. (Just got a 99.0 rated questing bow myself)
